gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew has a tall midsection that swallows most of the line's height, with wide gaps where curves leave stems. Luckiest Guy shouts in one poured, unbroken stroke, while Noto Sans Hebrew stays modern and quietly legible.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-hk: Strokes that look poured at a single width define Luckiest Guy. Noto Sans HK lifts its brush ends away and keeps large lowercase forms, so the loud cheer above meets a tidy, professional plain sans below.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-imperial-a: Approachable and a bit wry, Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic points the ends of its c outward like open pincers. And Luckiest Guy hums above it in a soft, featureless stroke, loud but never fussy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-inscriptio: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian gives every e and a a big open eye, with a deep band between baseline and mean line. Luckiest Guy is the one that gets loud, with no swelling where curves meet stems; Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian is the one that stays clean.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-jp: Luckiest Guy is cheerful and loud, its bowls running full without any thinning at the sides. Noto Sans JP sweeps open instead, tall in the x-height.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi lets its lowercase fill the line almost like capitals, with an open channel through each e. Luckiest Guy bends constant-width strokes like pipe; Noto Sans Kaithi simply reads.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Approachable from the first line, Luckiest Guy draws strokes like thin plastic tubing bent in a loop. Noto Sans Kannada follows with s curves open wide at both ends and a gentle bump up to capitals.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase, its curves never closing back on themselves. Over many lines it settles into a steady, approachable hum.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Luckiest Guy keeps one stroke thickness everywhere, cheerful and loud. And Noto Sans Khmer answers softly, its generous openings like chisel notches and small letters standing nearly capital-sized.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-khojki: No modulation in the stroke at all, just loud, cheerful Luckiest Guy. Noto Sans Khojki brings exits wide enough to pass light through and a large, clear eye on every e, which gives the pair its modern, tidy spirit.
